dev-out-2.reply:
How "On the page" came to be:

leo: "room for improvements?"
Agent: performance audit, three findings: the whole store file is rewritten on every comment, a page's list is built and compressed again on every load, and pins wait for a round trip after the page
Agent: pages come with their comments in them: the widget draws its pins without asking first, one round trip less
leo: "revert it sounds complicated"
Agent: reverted: pages no longer carry their comments in them, the widget asks for them as before

Dropped: comments carried inside the page. Why: too complicated for one round trip less.

Added 4 more cases like case-1, all failing for the same reason: keyFor spells any capital letter as hex instead of lowering it.

case-1-v1  FAQ.html -> got /_46_41_51, want /faq (all caps)
case-1-v2  Docs/index.html -> got /_44ocs/index, want /docs/index (capital folder)
case-1-v3  blog/MyPost.html -> got /blog/_4dy_50ost, want /blog/mypost (capital in a nested file)
case-1-v4  aboutUs.html -> got /about_55s, want /aboutus (capital mid-word)

So any file or folder name with a capital anywhere breaks, not just a leading one.
